resale_co.name: Resale Certificate of Occupancy (RCO)
requirements: Fire extinguisher: at least 2A:10BC, within 10 feet of the kitchen, no more than 5 feet off the floor, visible and mounted
CO alarm within 10 feet of all sleeping areas if there is a fuel-fired appliance or attached garage
Smoke alarm in each living space; battery units must be 10-year sealed; hard-wired or interconnected alarms in homes built after January 1977 must be kept working
House number visible on the house (a mailbox does not count)
Handrails on all stairs with 4 or more risers
Concrete sidewalks and curbs where applicable (Boulevard)
Buffer on windows at stairs or landings where applicable
No open permits: all permits paid, inspected and closed out
All structures in the right-of-way removed before the certificate is issued
Property visually inspected for compliance with general Township ordinances
resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the top of the Resale Certificate of Occupancy application and bring or send it with a check payable to Long Beach Township ($75 single family, $150 duplex), lock box or access code, a current survey (to scale, within 1 year), a flood elevation certificate if built after 1984, condo certification if applicable, and the recorded Deed Restriction. At minimum an application, check, survey and entry information are needed to schedule. Call to schedule the inspection: Wednesdays for the South End, Thursdays for the North End, weather permitting, with a daily limit. Construction Office, 6805 Long Beach Blvd, Brant Beach, NJ 08008; 609-361-6679; Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 3 pm.

resale_co.notes: The Resale CO also serves as the smoke, CO and extinguisher check for sales (see fire_cert). No construction office email is published; the Township general address is concierge@longbeachtownship.com. A second copy of the application (RESALE-CO-APP-1.pdf) is on the Online Forms page. Lead time and validity are not stated. Rentals: the Township has a Business-Rental application, and rental smoke/CO certificates in Long Beach Township are issued by the Ocean County Fire Marshal (see fire_cert notes); those are rental rules, not sale rules.

fire_cert.notes: The Ocean County Fire Marshal is Long Beach Township's fire code enforcing agency (LEA registry code C; directory Fire Official Dennis Allen, (732) 370-7360, dallen@co.ocean.nj.us). The County Fire Marshal's resale and rental page says it inspects Long Beach Township for rentals only, and the state directory names 'Long Beach Twp Constr Office' at 6805 Long Beach Blvd for smoke detector compliance, so for a sale the Township Resale CO inspection covers the smoke, CO and extinguisher check. The directory prints that office's phone as (732) 361-1000; the Township's own number is 609-361-1000, so the 732 area code looks like a directory error. For rentals the County Fire Marshal charges $45 / $90 / $161 by lead time and its certificate is valid 12 months (not a sale requirement). Five volunteer fire companies serve the township; they do not issue certificates.
